--- text
X|Y
--- keys
Type(a) Left Type(b) Cmd+Z
--- expect
X|aY
--- note
Consecutive typing joins into one undo group, but a caret move between
keystrokes ends that group. Type a into "X|Y" gives "XaY" with the caret at
column 2; Left moves the caret to column 1; typing b there gives "XbaY". Had
the two letters been typed without moving, one undo would erase both, because
adjacent insertions typed in quick succession are a single group. The Left is
a selection change, and a selection change closes the current group, so one
undo removes only the b, leaving "XaY" with the caret at column 1 where b was
inserted. Removing the a as well would mean the caret move failed to break the
run.
